title: Smoky Jamaican Chicken Dumplings
description: A twist on traditional Thai dumplings, featuring smoky Jamaican chicken. This dish is sure to satisfy your cravings.
instructions: 1. In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
2. Add the smoky chicken breast and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
3. In a small bowl, mix together the Jamaican allspice and 1 tablespoon of oil.
4. Brush the mixture onto the cooked chicken and set aside.
5. In a large bowl, combine the dumpling wrappers and 1/4 cup of water.
6. Mix until the wrappers are evenly moistened and pliable.
7. Divide the dough into 20 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
8. Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
9. Place a tablespoon of the cooked chicken onto the center of each disk.
10. Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together.
11. In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
12. Add the dumplings to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
